# The Windows driver's exports: its exported names, and @<ordinal> for an export with no name, which
# must equal these rows exactly, both ways. They must hold every entry point the interface header
# lists, which windows_policy.py policy checks before any download. One name per row; python3 -I
# tools/lib/windows_policy.py rows <set-dir> <driver> policy expected-exports prints them for a set.
